name: EasyThree
author: EasyThree

sections.description:
This plugin only works when used in combination with the EasyThree application.

EasyThree plugin

EasyThree plugin provides seamless connection and transformation of WooCommerce products into fully configurable 3D products, letting you sell configurable 3D products directly in your WordPress store.
Customers can preview, customize, and interact with products in real time, boosting engagement and confidence before purchase.

Features include:

  • WooCommerce 3d product configurator
  • WooCommerce Integration: Link 3D scenes directly to product attributes, variations and pricing.
  • Interactive Customization: Customers can swap materials, textures, and product parts in real time.
  • Camera Views & Animations: Highlight product details with cinematic transitions.
  • AR & VR Ready: Native support for iOS AR Quick Look and Android WebXR.
  • Customers can view products in their environment using mobile devices — no app required.

EasyThree App

EasyThree application is a powerful, user‑friendly 3D scene builder that lets you import models, customize textures, lighting, camera views etc. then publish directly to websites or online stores.

It transforms static 3D models into interactive, customizable web experiences — perfect for product showcases, AR/VR previews, and immersive e‑commerce. With bulk export capabilities, EasyThree is ideal for managing large catalogs and rapid prototyping.
sections.installation:
Admin Installer via search

  1. Visit the Add New plugin screen and search for “EasyThree”.
  2. Click the “Install Now” button.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. You can Access EasyThree settings from the Tools menu.

Admin Installer via zip

  1. Visit the Add New plugin screen and click the “Upload Plugin” button.
  2. Click the “Browse…” button and select the zip file of our plugin.
  3. Click “Install Now” button.
  4. Once uploading is done, activate EasyThree.
  5. You can Access EasyThree settings from the Tools menu.

More information on using the plugin can be found here.
